styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Claude warm terracotta primary #d97757 on dark warm backgrounds (#1a1915), warm white text #faf9f5, jade spring-green accents
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: 8px radius panels, 4px radius buttons, warm border accents from Claude border tokens
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: title: STKaiti/KaiTi serif; body: Claude text-900 #faf9f5 with warm tones
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px grid, generous whitespace, 240px left panel, 56px right toolbar
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: semi-transparent glass panels, terracotta-accent sliders, tab underline indicators
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: backdrop-filter blur panels, warm shadows, Claude card #2c2c2b layered backgrounds
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle hover transitions, smooth opacity fades, warm glow focus states

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Claude warm terracotta theme overlaying Claude dark tokens. Full-screen immersive game layout (no TopNav/Sidebar). Semi-transparent panels with backdrop-filter blur. KaiTi serif titles, Claude warm body text. Spring jade green accents for wuxia fantasy. 1920x1080 desktop baseline, responsive to mobile.

pages.title: 性别选择与角色全览
